_notes: Operations Research extension: capacity-constrained medical-kit and patient distribution.
The model is documented in OR_MODEL.md before this file is used.
All quantities that OSM/SUMO do not publish are in data/or_test_data.json and are labelled SYNTHETIC.
Road capacity is an explicit estimate from lane count and road type; it is not a measured capacity.
Background lane flow is separate from the 48-ambulance fleet and is zero in the shipped test data because no measured value exists.
Prohibited lanes are excluded from the lane graph. Network vehicle-class restrictions are always enforced; explicit closures can be added below.
The standard transportation tableau (VAM/least-cost/NWC/MODI) does not contain lane capacities. The network-constrained MILP enforces them.

road_capacity.notice: No measured lane capacity is present in the repository. C_e = vehicles_per_lane_hour(type) * lane_planning_hours * (1 - reserve_fraction). This is a documented planning estimate, not a measurement.
